infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Yummi uses the camera to photograph the inside of your fridge and identify ingredients.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Yummi uses the microphone so you can add ingredients and say “done” while cooking.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Yummi uses speech recognition to understand what you say while your hands are busy cooking.
